modules.title: 一篇帮助文章怎样被读者和搜索系统理解
SEO 改善哪些基础条件

items.title: 内容先回答真实问题
items.text: 页面应提供有用、准确的内容，标题和正文告诉读者与搜索系统这页在解决什么；复制关键词或空泛宣传不能代替答案。

items.title: 爬虫通过链接和 HTML 阅读页面
items.text: 搜索引擎通过爬虫沿着链接发现页面，读取页面的 title、meta description、标题层级和图片 alt。若纯靠 JS 渲染且初始 HTML 为空，爬虫可能抓不到内容。

items.title: AI 生成的页面通常需要补齐 SEO 细节
items.text: AI 常遗漏独有标题与描述、合理的 h1-h3 层级、图片 alt 文本以及 article/nav/main 等语义标签。上线前需要检查并补全这些基础。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: SEO 不是购买排名，也不是只改几个关键词。搜索结果会受查询意图、竞争、质量和系统判断等多种因素影响；清楚内容和技术可访问性是必要工作，却不能保证流量或名次。

lessonPractice.title: 旧帮助页改版后要保留原链接带来的访问者。哪个做法更合适？

options.label: 把旧 URL 重定向到内容真正对应的新页面，并检查新旧链接访问结果
options.feedback: 对。访问者和搜索系统都会被带到相关的新内容，旧地址不会直接变成死路。

options.label: 直接删除旧页，不做任何处理，让搜索引擎下次自己更新
options.feedback: 旧链接的读者会得到错误页，相关信号和可用性都会受影响。

options.label: 把所有旧页都跳到首页，不管原来讲什么
options.feedback: 首页未必回答原链接的需求。重定向应尽量对应真实替代内容。

en.title: After an old help page is redesigned, visitors from its existing link still need a destination. What approach fits best?

options.label: Redirect the old URL to the new page that truly corresponds to its content, then check both old and new link behavior
options.feedback: Correct. Visitors and search systems reach relevant replacement content instead of a dead end.

options.label: Delete the old page with no handling and let search engines update later
options.feedback: People following old links get an error page, harming usability and related signals.

options.label: Send every old page to the homepage regardless of what it covered
options.feedback: The home page may not answer the need expressed by the old link. Redirects should match real replacement content when possible.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查这篇帮助文章的 SEO 基础：标题是否准确回答问题、正文层级是否清楚、关键内容和链接能否正常访问。不要承诺排名；改完后用普通浏览器打开页面，并检查旧链接是否到达对应内容。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Check the SEO fundamentals of this help article: whether its title accurately answers the problem, headings are clear, and key content and links are accessible. Do not promise rankings. Afterward, open it in a normal browser and check that old links reach corresponding content.

learning.assumes: You have used a search engine to find an answer or published a page others need to find through a link.
learning.outcome: You can ask for real, clearly structured, accessible content and distinguish SEO fundamentals from a ranking promise.

modules.title: How a help article becomes understandable to people and search systems

items.title: Content answers a real question first
items.text: A page needs useful, accurate content. Its title and sections tell people and search systems what it solves; keyword stuffing or vague promotion cannot replace an answer.

items.title: Crawlers read pages through links and HTML
items.text: Search engines follow links to discover pages and read title, meta description, heading structure, and image alt attributes. Pure client-rendered apps with empty initial HTML may hide content from crawlers.

items.title: AI-generated pages often need SEO polish
items.text: AI often misses unique titles and meta descriptions, single-h1 hierarchy, image alt text, and semantic HTML (article, nav, main). Check and fix these basics before launching.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: SEO is neither buying rank nor changing a few keywords. Results depend on query intent, competition, quality, and system judgment among other factors. Clear content and technical accessibility are necessary work but cannot promise traffic or position.
